# Bodilicious

> Bodilicious is a certified, registered Indian beauty brand making dermatologically tested, science-backed skincare and haircare — hand-made, chemical-free formulations targeting specific concerns (acne, pigmentation, aging, hair loss, dandruff, dullness) rather than generic routines.

Bodilicious sells direct-to-consumer online at https://bodilicious.in, shipping across India with free shipping on orders over ₹1500. The brand is based in Tamil Nadu, India.

## Store

- [Shop all products](https://bodilicious.in/shop): Full catalog of skincare, haircare, body, and lip products.
- [Skin care](https://bodilicious.in/shop?category=skin): Serums, cleansers, moisturizers, sunscreens, eye creams.
- [Hair care](https://bodilicious.in/shop?category=hair): Shampoos, conditioners, hair oils and serums for growth and dandruff.
- [Body care](https://bodilicious.in/shop?category=body): Soaps and body washes.
- [Lip care](https://bodilicious.in/shop?category=lip): Lip balms and tinted lip products.
- [Makeup](https://bodilicious.in/shop?category=makeup): Foundation and lip color.
- [Current offers](https://bodilicious.in/offers): Active discounts and bundles.
- [Ritual Finder](https://bodilicious.in/ritual-finder): Guided tool that recommends a product routine based on skin/hair concerns.

## Key active ingredients

Niacinamide, Retinol, Vitamin C, Hyaluronic Acid, Salicylic Acid, Azelaic Acid, AHA/BHA, Ketoconazole, Kojic Acid, Peptides, Ceramides.

## Policies

- [Shipping & Returns](https://bodilicious.in/shipping-refund): Free shipping over ₹1500; ships on business days; 7-day return window on unused products with original receipt; refunds processed within 7-10 business days of the return being received.
- [FAQs](https://bodilicious.in/faqs): Common questions on products, shipping, and payments.
- [How to Order](https://bodilicious.in/how-to-order): Step-by-step checkout guide.
- [Terms](https://bodilicious.in/terms): Terms and conditions.
- [Privacy](https://bodilicious.in/privacy): Privacy policy.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Prices are in Indian Rupees (INR, ₹) unless a currency switcher is used on-site.
- Individual product pages (https://bodilicious.in/product/{PID}) carry full name, ingredients, price, availability, and rating for each SKU — see /sitemap.xml for the current list.
- For order status or support, direct users to WhatsApp (+91 9894451947) or the Contact page rather than guessing order details.
